`/.github/workflows/build.yml`, `/.github/workflows/release.yml`, `/.github/workflows/test.yml`, `/.github/workflows/image-build.yml`|Updated Go matrix/toolchain from `1.24.x` → `1.25.x`; test job preserves PATH when sudo-ing; Trivy action bumped to `aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.35.0`.| |**Go module & deps**
`go.mod`|Raised `go` directive to `1.25.x` and bumped numerous direct/indirect dependencies (testing, Prometheus, k8s.io/*, golang.org/x/*, grpc/protobuf, etc.).| |**Container images & Dockerfiles**
`images/Dockerfile`, `images/Dockerfile.debug`, `images/Dockerfile.thick`, `Dockerfile.microshift`, `Dockerfile.openshift`|Switched build-stage base images from `golang:1.24` → `golang:1.25` and updated OpenShift/MicroShift builder/runtime tags; other Dockerfile logic unchanged.| |**CI operator config**
`.ci-operator.yaml`|Updated `build_root_image.tag` to `rhel-9-release-golang-1.25-openshift-4.22`.| |**Device ID sorting (types, callers, tests)**
`pkg/types/types.go`, `pkg/checkpoint/checkpoint.go`, `pkg/kubeletclient/kubeletclient.go`, `pkg/checkpoint/checkpoint_test.go`|Added exported `SortDeviceIDs(resourceMap map[string]*ResourceInfo)` to lexicographically sort `DeviceIDs`; `GetPodResourceMap` callers invoke it; tests adjusted to expect sorted order.| |**Kubeconfig & per-node cert handling**
`pkg/k8sclient/kubeconfig.go`|Refactored per-node kubeconfig creation to copy bootstrap config and clear bootstrap auth fields; replaced pod-list validation with `Discovery().ServerVersion()` for per-node cert validation; improved error propagation and CSR retry/reload logic when CA is unknown.| |**Kubelet/checkpoint callers**
`pkg/checkpoint/checkpoint.go`, `pkg/kubeletclient/kubeletclient.go`|Callers now invoke `types.SortDeviceIDs(...)` before returning resource maps to ensure deterministic device ordering.| |**CNI server: STATUS/GC handling & tests**
`pkg/server/server.go`, `pkg/server/thick_cni_test.go`|Treat `STATUS` and `GC` as plugin-level commands: skip deriving pod-scoped k8s args, allow nil `*types.K8sArgs`, and bypass required env var extraction; added tests validating STATUS/GC succeed without pod-scoped env vars.| |**Multus behavior & informer tests**
`pkg/multus/multus.go`, `pkg/multus/multus_cni100_test.go`|`conflistStatus` now returns early for CNI versions <1.1.0; informer tests removed WaitForCacheSync and explicitly seed informer stores via `GetStore().Add()` (delayed-add flows updated to seed both fake client and informer store).| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes

- Line 18: The grpc dependency version in go.mod (google.golang.org/grpc
v1.73.0) is vulnerable; update the module to at least v1.79.3 by changing the
version entry for google.golang.org/grpc to v1.79.3 (or later) and then run
module tooling to resolve transitive changes (e.g., update with go commands and
run go mod tidy) so the project builds against the fixed gRPC release and
removes the vulnerable version from the dependency graph.

In `@pkg/k8sclient/kubeconfig.go`:
- Around line 116-118: The code currently logs non-x509 errors from
ServerVersion() but leaves cfg pointing at the invalid per-node config so
kubernetes.NewForConfig(cfg) will use a bad config; update the control flow in
the ServerVersion() handling (the block that calls ServerVersion() and logs via
logging.Errorf) to either return the error immediately or explicitly fall back
to the bootstrap config by reassigning cfg to the bootstrap credentials before
continuing; locate the ServerVersion() call and the subsequent
kubernetes.NewForConfig(cfg) usage and ensure that on any non-x509 error you do
one of those two actions so kubernetes.NewForConfig never receives the known-bad
per-node cfg.

In `@pkg/kubeletclient/kubeletclient.go`:
- Around line 146-147: The sort mutates cached kubelet state because
types.SortDeviceIDs(resourceMap) operates on slices that alias rc.resources
entries via dev.DeviceIds; to fix, when building resourceMap inside
GetPodResourceMap, deep-copy each dev.DeviceIds slice into a new slice (e.g.,
append a nil slice or make+copy) before assigning into resourceMap so in-place
sorting of resourceMap cannot change rc.resources or race with concurrent calls;
update the code paths that insert dev.DeviceIds into resourceMap to use the
copied slice and keep the rest unchanged.

In `@pkg/types/types.go`:
- Around line 184-188: The loop in SortDeviceIDs dereferences rInfo without
checking for nil, which can panic for nil map values; update the loop in
SortDeviceIDs to first check if rInfo == nil and continue if so, then retain the
existing check for rInfo.DeviceIDs != nil before calling sort.Strings on
ResourceInfo.DeviceIDs so nil entries are safely skipped.
